title: fix(service-messaging): the email channel answers unavailable while only the log transport is live

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：没配发信方式（只有「写日志」的假通道）时，邮件渠道不再自称可用；通知不再为邮件写投递记录，而是记一条「未配置发信」的抑制原因；已写下的投递记录被拒发，不再标成「成功」。
- 为什么改：执行 cloud#2549 裁定 B 第 ③ 项。过去所有托管租户在管理员配好邮箱前，邮件通知都显示「已送达」，其实一封没发。
- 风险与回滚：只动 service-messaging 的邮件渠道一个文件；没有实现 isConfigured 的第三方邮件服务行为不变。回滚即还原本 PR 一次提交。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-messaging/src/email-channel.ts` 的 `emailTransportRefusal` 与 `isAvailable` / `send` 两处调用；其次是测试文件末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/email-channel.test.ts`，预期 47 个全绿，其中 `a LogTransport is no transport (#30510)` 下 5 个。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #30510

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n -i -c "logtransport|log transport|transport_not_configured|email channel|e-mail channel" -- 'skills/**'` has no hit (exit 1)

## What changes

plugin-email registers the `email` service on every boot. With no `mail` settings saved, its live transport is the `LogTransport`: a send succeeds, writes `sys_email`, and no mail leaves the process. The `email` channel answered `isAvailable()` from "an email service is registered", so fan-out wrote a delivery row and the dispatcher marked it `success` while nobody was mailed. Every hosted tenant is in this state until its admin configures mail (objectstack-ai/cloud#2549, ruling B, item 3).

- `email-channel.ts`: new `emailTransportRefusal(email)` asks the service's own deliverability answer, `IEmailService.isConfigured()` (already on the spec contract, already implemented by plugin-email from the live transport and already following the `mail` settings hot swap). An explicit `false` makes `isAvailable()` answer `{ available: false, reason: 'transport_not_configured' }` and makes `send()` refuse with that same reason, graded permanent, without calling the service. It is read on every call, never cached, so a transport the settings swap in after boot flips the channel back with no restart.
- `EmailSenderSurface` (the channel's structural view of the service) gains the optional `isConfigured?(): boolean`, mirroring the contract member.
- The existing reason token is reused. No new reason, no new error code, no spec change, no plugin-email change.

## Tests

New top-level describe `email channel — a LogTransport is no transport (#30510)` in `email-channel.test.ts` (the package's shared harness for this channel). Its double mirrors plugin-email's `EmailService` on the one axis that matters: `isConfigured()` answers from a swappable live transport.

- unavailable with `transport_not_configured` while the transport only logs;
- `send()` refuses with the same reason, graded permanent, and the service's `send` is never called (no fake `sys_email` row);
- swap to a real transport: available and delivers; swap back: unavailable again;
- control: a service with no `isConfigured` stays available and still delivers;
- end to end (MessagingService + MemoryNotificationOutbox + dispatcher): an emit on a log-only deployment writes no delivery row and reports the suppression; after the swap one row lands `success`.

The producer half is already pinned in plugin-email (`email-plugin.mail-settings.test.ts`, "registered email service — isConfigured follows the mail settings": `false` on the out-of-the-box boot, `true` after a saved SMTP config, no restart).

## Acceptance notes

- **Absent `isConfigured` is read as unknown and keeps today's behaviour (available).** The contract makes the member optional and says a consumer must not read absence as `true`; this channel keeps sending through such a service, as it did before, because refusing would mute every host-supplied email service that predates the member. This follows the same choice the fan-out ruling made for a channel with no `isAvailable`. Only an explicit `false` refuses. If the seat reads the contract the other way, flipping it is a one-line change in `emailTransportRefusal`.
- The real composition (plugin-email + service-messaging in one kernel) is pinned as two halves joined by the spec contract: service-messaging cannot import plugin-email (no dependency), and a dogfood pin is outside this card's file surface.
- Serial note: this PR does not touch plugin-email, `EmailService` or the `LogTransport`, so it does not overlap seat 5's #30212 row 3.
